first.rationale: The simultaneous declines in onboarding completion and activation make onboarding simplification the most directly evidenced, durable intervention. Prior records indicate it improved completion, time-to-value, early adoption, and first-week activation. Promotional pricing addresses the competitor but has documented 30-day retention harm, which conflicts with the sustainable qualified-revenue objective. Verify both onboarding records before committing to confirm segment fit and guardrails.
